name: Cloudflare MCP Server
shortDescription: Manage Cloudflare Workers, KV namespaces, D1 databases, Vectorize, Hyperdrive, and DNS zones.
longDescription: Interact with Cloudflare developer platform directly from your coding assistant: deploy and tail Workers, query D1 serverless SQL databases, inspect KV key-values, and manage DNS records.
author: cloudflare

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
envVars.description: Cloudflare API Token with Workers & D1 permissions.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Cloudflare Account ID found in dashboard URL or overview.

tools.name: d1_query
tools.description: Execute SQL queries against a Cloudflare D1 database.

tools.name: kv_get
tools.description: Retrieve key value from Cloudflare Workers KV.

tools.name: list_workers
tools.description: List all deployed Cloudflare Workers in the account.

tools.name: get_worker_logs
tools.description: Tail live execution logs for a Cloudflare Worker.

installSteps.title: Configure Cloudflare Token
installSteps.description: Create a token with Account > Cloudflare Workers > Edit permissions.
